episodes.title: Now Entering Sun Valley
episodes.summary: Rattled after a brutal fall and worried by her mom and sister's obsession with the sport, Kat eyes a life beyond skating. Suddenly, a new offer arrives.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Family
episodes.summary: Drastic decisions change Kat's career path, but an unexpected competitor immediately threatens her chances. At home, Serena struggles with Carol.

episodes.title: Proceed with Caution
episodes.summary: Trust issues force Dasha to get creative with training, bringing the skaters out of their comfort zones. Suspicions grow around Mitch.

episodes.title: Keep Pinecrest Wild
episodes.summary: Facing family pressure, Jenn struggles to hide her injury while Serena's progress makes her a target. Justin and Kat's "connection" takes a turn.

episodes.title: Two for $40
episodes.summary: Marcus is torn between his old crush and a new flirtation. Carol's new low leads her to an unlikely ally. Justin's latest mistake cuts deep.

episodes.title: Have a Nice Day!
episodes.summary: Carol's recovery has a shaky start. Kat grows closer to Justin, while a fight with Jenn has bitter consequences. Marcus faces a hard decision.

episodes.title: Healing Times May Vary
episodes.summary: Dasha's painful secrets come to light. Fixated on winning, Kat puts her mental health at risk. Serena's dad returns with a complicated proposal.

episodes.title: Hell Is Real
episodes.summary: Kat's mental health crisis reaches a breaking point, triggering widespread damage. Mandy has an emergency, and Serena slips into loneliness.

episodes.title: #1 Mom
episodes.summary: Kat's episode brings destructive fallout for Marcus and Justin. Carol and Mitch contemplate a big step, and Serena exposes a secret about Kat's fall.

episodes.title: Kiss and Cry
episodes.summary: Kat and Justin's romance and Olympic dreams teeter on an edge while the relationships around them skid toward their own crossroads.
